quotes.text: Stop thinking about agents as products. Start thinking about them as a system with four layers. Each layer has different needs.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Introduces the four-layer model that structures the whole episode.

quotes.text: You are not just using an agent anymore. You are hiring one. It comes with all the governance machinery that you would expect when hiring any other system.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable framing of agents as accountable identities rather than features.

quotes.text: You cannot govern what you cannot see. Agent 365 makes those agents visible. You cannot have control without identity. Entra agent ID makes those agents controllable.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Summarizes how discovery and identity together solve the shadow agent problem.

quotes.text: Grounding is the difference between interesting agents and trustworthy agents. Interesting is when the agent sounds smart. Trustworthy is when the agent is actually right
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Crisply explains why grounding in real data is non-negotiable.

quotes.text: Not because co-pilot studio is bad, it's a perfectly good place to build. But Foundry is where you build at scale. Co-pilot studio is where you prototype. Foundry is where you operate.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a practical rule for when to move an agent from Copilot Studio to Foundry.

chapters.title: From chatbots to agents that operate

takeaways: Think of Microsoft agents as four layers, experience, agent, runtime and governance, each with different owners and controls, instead of picking products at random.
Agent 365 and Entra Agent ID turn agents into governed identities with least-privilege access, conditional access, audit trails and instant revocation, which addresses shadow agents.
Start with one well-scoped agent in Copilot Studio grounded in your own data, register it in Agent 365, measure its impact and graduate it to Foundry for scale.
hook: Many organizations are building fragile agents without governance, duplicating work and losing track of what runs in their tenant. This field guide is for IT leaders, architects and makers who need to make sense of Microsoft's agent landscape after Build 2026. You get a four-layer model plus practical guidance on Agent 365, Entra Agent ID, Foundry Agent Service and grounding.
